title: Doss
desc: Rajeshwari and Antony, a young couple, have major class differences. She decides to elope after her father kills her sister for marrying a man from a lower caste.

title: Pattikattu Ponniah
desc: A farmer heads to the city to find a way to pay off his father's debts. However, things take an unexpected twist when he turns to wrestling as a profession.

title: Thambikku Entha Ooru
desc: Seeing Balu's spendthrift and carefree attitude, his father sends him to his friend's house in a village to get reformed. Things get complicated when he gets entangled in a love triangle.

title: Vidiyum Vari Kaathiru
desc: Raja runs into Rajaratnam, a millionaire, who gets impressed by his attitude towards life. Rajaratnam has an intellectually disabled daughter, but he believes that she will be cured if she is married.

title: Puthu Paatu
desc: When a woman falls in love with her brother's personal manager, she believes their connection is genuine. However, when she discovers he's already in a relationship she is devastated.
